svg.title: Ila signs a limited trial as Cecil stamps it and names the clinic inspection.
svg.desc: The limited-activation form fills the foreground. Ila adds a public review at seventy-two hours, Vale accepts, and Cecil stamps VOLUNTARY beside a cancellation route that loops back to the programme before announcing Rook Clinic as the first dawn inspection.
svg.text: Page 10, panel 5 · Wide low shot along the signed trial form towards the four principals

text.tspan: Ila secures a public review, signs the limited trial
and sends the inspection to Rook Clinic at dawn.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
